description: European LNG terminal levels from GIE ALSI+: LNG inventory in the tanks (1000 m3 LNG and GWh), daily send-out into the gas grid, and declared maximum inventory and send-out capacity — for the EU, a country (e.g. Spain "ES", France "FR"), an LNG operator or one terminal. Omit dates for the latest gas day. Served with Pipeworx's own GIE key, so callers need none; pass your own free GIE key as _apiKey to use it instead.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own GIE API key (sent as the x-key header); Pipeworx supplies its platform key when omitted. Register free at https://agsi.gie.eu/account.

company.description: LNG operator EIC code (operator_eic from gie_storage_facilities with dataset "lng"). Needs country.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "ES", "FR", "NL", "DE". Omit or pass "EU" for the EU aggregate.

days.description: Max gas days to return (1-300). Default 1 with no dates (latest day), 30 with dates.

facility.description: LNG terminal EIC code (facility eic from gie_storage_facilities with dataset "lng"). Needs country and company.

name: gie_lng_terminals
title: Gie Lng Terminals
